subtitle: Cross-reference for 27/Sep/2026: Polymarket in the reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT, the SIX national polls of 24/Sep, which are still the most recent, Datafolha BR-00304/2026, Palver BR-09587/2026, PoderData/Aya BR-01739/2026, Alfa Inteligência/TMC BR-02512/2026, Real Time Big Data BR-04202/2026 and Futura/100% Cidades BR-05268/2026, the Datafolha poll on the Supreme Court released on 26/Sep and the press flow of 26 and 27/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 42.50% (USD 12.40M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, unchanged raw and down 0.48pp normalized, reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he rises 1.00pp, to 25.45% (USD 1.04M). POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep, still the most recent, measure him from 43% at Palver, tied, to 38.4% at Futura, 2 points behind, and he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in one of the six.
fortes: In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he rises 1.00pp raw and 0.75pp normalized, to 25.45%.

At Datafolha on 24/Sep, the pollster with the highest reliability in the table, he leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by 40% to 36% and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) by 47% to 45%, and it is the only one of the six national polls of that day that puts him ahead head to head.

Measuring each house against its own previous wave, he gained ground in three of the six: Datafolha, where the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) gap widened from 3 to 4 points, Palver, where he went from 1 point behind to a tie, and PoderData, where the lead widened from 1 to 2 points.

🔒 Datafolha of 24/Sep measures how locked in the choice is ten days before the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): 80% of the electorate say they are completely decided, and among his voters the figure is 87%, the highest on either side.

In the Datafolha state breakdown released on 25/Sep he leads in Pernambuco by 60% to 24% and is numerically ahead in Minas Gerais, by 39% to 37%, in a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo).
fracos: Unchanged at 42.50% in the winner contract, and with Flávio Bolsonaro rising the gap widens from 13.65pp to 14.75pp, the second widening in a row between confirmed readings. Normalized by the pair sum, which rose from 98.65 to 99.75, the loss is 0.48pp.
In the series recorded since 14 April his price sits 25.00pp from the top, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 8.00pp from the floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr.

🔴 He loses ground in three of the six national polls of 24/Sep, always against the previous wave of the same pollster: at Real Time his lead fell from 8 to 4 points, at Futura he went from 0.6 point ahead to 2 points behind, and at Alfa, Exame reports a fall from 14 to 7 points in the pollster's own series.

⚖️ In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing he loses in four of the six houses, and at Futura the deficit of 5.7 points, 43.7% against 49.4%, falls OUTSIDE the 2.2pp margin of that poll.
In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he trails in São Paulo, by 38% to 33%, in Rio de Janeiro, by 44% to 38%, and in the Federal District, by 41% to 34% (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo).

⚖️ The president of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) (Superior Electoral Court), Kassio Nunes Marques, suspended by preliminary injunction the Lula campaign jingle that links Flávio Bolsonaro to the rachadinha and to the Master case: the decision was taken on 22/Sep, became public on 26/Sep and was submitted to the full bench of the court (Estadão and CartaCapital).
candidates.analise: Lula stayed at 42.50% in the winner contract (USD 12.40M cumulative volume) in the reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT, unchanged raw, and gave up 0.48pp normalized, because the pair sum rose from 98.65 to 99.75. With Flávio Bolsonaro rising, the gap widens from 13.65pp to 14.75pp, the second widening in a row between confirmed readings. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he rises 1.00pp raw and 0.75pp normalized, to 25.45%. 🗳️ There was no national voting intention poll from 25 to 27/Sep, and the six from 24/Sep still disagree about him: in the first round they run from 7 points ahead at Alfa/TMC to 2 points behind at Futura, and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) he leads only at Datafolha, by 47% to 45%. 📰 On 26/Sep, at a rally in São Paulo, he linked Flávio Bolsonaro to the Master and [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) cases (Folha de S.Paulo and Brasil 247), and the president of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) (Superior Electoral Court), Kassio Nunes Marques, suspended by preliminary injunction the Lula campaign jingle that links Flávio Bolsonaro to the rachadinha and to the Master case: the decision was taken on 22/Sep, became public on 26/Sep and was submitted to the full bench of the court (Estadão and CartaCapital). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news flow: it measures both sides, each with its own timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 57.25% (USD 11.96M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, up 1.10pp raw and 0.48pp normalized, reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he stays at 74.50% (USD 1.19M). POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep, the most recent, measure him from 40.4% at Futura, where he leads, to 33% at Alfa/TMC, and he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in four of the six.
fortes: Rises 1.10pp in the winner contract, to 57.25%, and the gap widens from 13.65pp to 14.75pp, the second widening in a row between confirmed readings.
His price is 4.45pp from the top of the series, 61.70% recorded on 21/Sep.

⭐ He leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in four of the six national polls of 24/Sep, which are still the most recent: 49.4% to 43.7% at Futura, 48% to 45% at Palver, 46% to 45% at PoderData and 45% to 44% at Real Time, with a 43% tie at Alfa.

📌 The Futura advantage, of 5.7 points, is the only one of the six that falls OUTSIDE the margin of the poll itself, and the house describes it as a statistical advantage. It is not the first time in this base: of the 34 [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) readings between the two already recorded in the panel, 11 fell outside the margin and 8 of them favoured him.
In the Datafolha state breakdown released on 25/Sep he leads in São Paulo, by 38% to 33%, in Rio de Janeiro, by 44% to 38%, and in the Federal District, by 41% to 34% (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo).

⚖️ The president of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) (Superior Electoral Court), Kassio Nunes Marques, suspended by preliminary injunction the Lula campaign jingle that links Flávio Bolsonaro to the rachadinha and to the Master case: the decision was taken on 22/Sep, became public on 26/Sep and was submitted to the full bench of the court (Estadão and CartaCapital).
fracos: Normalized by the pair sum, which rose from 98.65 to 99.75, his rise in the winner contract is only 0.48pp: more than half of the raw rise is the pair's overpricing.
In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he holds still at 74.50% raw and gives up 0.75pp normalized, because Lula's price there rose.

He leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in only one of the six national polls of 24/Sep, Futura, by 40.4% to 38.4%, and trails in the other five, with the widest distance at Alfa/TMC, 33% against 40%.
In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he trails in Pernambuco, by 60% to 24%, and is numerically behind in Minas Gerais, by 39% to 37%, in a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico).

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and he confirmed an exchange from September 2025 about it, citing a private financing contract that was not made public.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro rose 1.10pp in the winner contract, to 57.25% (USD 11.96M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT, but only 0.48pp normalized, because the pair sum rose from 98.65 to 99.75. With that the gap widens from 13.65pp to 14.75pp, the second widening in a row between confirmed readings, and his price is 4.45pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he stays at 74.50% raw, down 0.75pp normalized. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 24/Sep, still the most recent, he leads the first round in one, Futura, by 40.4% to 38.4%, and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the six. ⚖️ The president of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) (Superior Electoral Court), Kassio Nunes Marques, suspended by preliminary injunction the Lula campaign jingle that links Flávio Bolsonaro to the rachadinha and to the Master case: the decision was taken on 22/Sep, became public on 26/Sep and was submitted to the full bench of the court (Estadão and CartaCapital). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news flow: it measures both sides, each with its own timestamp.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.05% in the winner contract (USD 5.12M cumulative volume) and 44.40% (USD 0.29M cumulative volume) in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place contract, up 3.05pp raw and 3.37pp normalized by the book sum, in the reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT. POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep measure him from 2% at Palver to 6% at Alfa, PoderData and Real Time.
fortes: ⭐ Moves ahead of Renan Santos in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book: rises 3.05pp raw and 3.37pp normalized, to 44.40%, and the distance, which had Renan Santos 4.15pp ahead, turns into Augusto Cury 2.90pp ahead.

🔑 PoderData tests him in a pairing that contradicts the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) order: he beats Lula by 45% to 42%, the same score as the house wave of 17/Sep, and loses to Flávio Bolsonaro by 39% to 41%.
He is third in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in three of the six national polls of 24/Sep, with 6% at Alfa, PoderData and Real Time.
In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he has 7% in São Paulo, ahead of the other third way names in that state (G1).
fracos: The third place book swings a lot: in the points recorded in the backup since 22/Sep, his price there varied from 3.8pp to 12pp per day.
He gives way at Datafolha, from 6% to 5%, and at PoderData, from 8% to 6%, always against the previous wave of the same house.
At Futura he lost third place to Ronaldo Caiado: he fell from 6.5% to 5.6% while the other rose from 4.5% to 5.7%.
In the winner contract he remains at the floor of the book, 0.05%, and is priced below what his cumulative volume would suggest, USD 5.02M.
At Palver, which is the source of the polling side of the divergence chart in this round, he has only 2%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury rose 3.05pp raw in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book, to 44.40% (USD 0.29M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT, and 3.37pp normalized, because the book sum fell from 102.85 to 101.90, and moved ahead of Renan Santos in that book. The distance, in the series of confirmed readings, was 19.95pp, 5.25pp, 3.05pp, 4.15pp, 4.05pp, 4.45pp and 4.15pp with Renan Santos ahead, and is now 2.90pp with Augusto Cury ahead. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 24/Sep he runs from 2% at Palver to 6% at Alfa, PoderData and Real Time, and PoderData has him beating Lula in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) by 45% to 42%. 📰 On 27/Sep, in Belo Horizonte, he defended abolishing or taxing the bets, according to Metrópoles.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.45% (USD 14.52M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, unchanged, and 41.50% (USD 0.43M cumulative volume) in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place contract, down 4.00pp raw and 3.51pp normalized by the book sum, in the reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT. POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep measure him from 2.4% at Futura to 8% at Palver.
fortes: 🏆 His contract in the winner book is still the one with the LARGEST cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 14.52M against USD 14.10M for Tarcísio de Freitas's.

🔑 And in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place book too: USD 1.37M, above the USD 1.19M of Flávio Bolsonaro's contract, which is the one paying 74.50% there. Volume does not follow price in either book.
📰 According to Estadão of 25/Sep, The Economist called him a combative libertarian and named him the most suitable candidate.
He is the most voted of the third way at Palver, with 8%, and second at Real Time, with 6%.
fracos: 🔴 Loses the lead of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book to Augusto Cury: falls 4.00pp raw and 3.51pp normalized, to 41.50%, and sits 2.90pp behind, after being 4.15pp ahead in the reading confirmed on 26/Sep.
🔴 He falls from 11% to 8% at Palver against the house wave of 21/Sep, the largest fall of any name in that poll.

⚠️ The six national polls of the SAME day measure him at 8% at Palver, 6% at Real Time, 3% at Datafolha and at PoderData and 2.4% at Futura: the highest reading is more than three times the lowest, and because the six came out on the same day that distance cannot be put down to the calendar.
In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairings he is the most distant opponent from Lula: 34% to 44% at Palver and 37% to 43% at Alfa.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos fell 4.00pp raw in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book, to 41.50% (USD 0.43M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT, and 3.51pp normalized, and lost the lead of that book to Augusto Cury, who ended 2.90pp ahead. In the points recorded in the backup since 22/Sep, his price there varied from 4pp to 9.5pp per day. In the winner contract he stays at 0.45%. 🏆 His contract in the winner book is still the one with the largest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 14.52M against USD 14.10M for Tarcísio de Freitas's, and the same happens in the second place book, USD 1.37M against USD 1.19M for Flávio Bolsonaro's contract, which pays 74.50% there. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 24/Sep he runs from 8% at Palver to 2.4% at Futura, and since all six came out on the same day that distance cannot be attributed to the calendar.

In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairings of the other pollsters he trails, by 42% to 43% at Alfa and 42% to 44% at Palver, both within the margin.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT, at the floor of the book, with USD 7.55M cumulative. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and none of the six national polls of 24/Sep tests him in a presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in this reading, so there is no move to explain, and his series high in the winner contract is 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by any of the six national polls of the day nor tested in a [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round. His winner contract has accumulated USD 7.55M, a larger volume than that of Augusto Cury, who is tested by the six houses and has USD 5.02M.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, with USD 7.71M cumulative. zema.fortes: ⭐ His [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing was tight at two of the six pollsters: Futura puts him AHEAD of Lula, by 43.8% to 43.3%, and Palver puts him behind by 43% to 45%, both within the margin. In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he has 4% in Minas Gerais, the state he governed (G1).
zema.fracos: Stays at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he stands at 1% in five of the six national polls of 24/Sep and at 0.9% at Futura, and at Alfa he loses the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing by 39% to 46%.

cruzamento: The day moved the third place book more than the winner book. 🥉 Between the confirmed readings of 26 and 27/Sep, Augusto Cury rises 3.05pp, to 44.40%, and Renan Santos falls 4.00pp, to 41.50%, with 3.37pp and 3.51pp normalized, and the lead of that book changes hands: the distance goes from Renan Santos 4.15pp ahead to Augusto Cury 2.90pp ahead. 💹 In the winner contract, the reading confirmed on 27/Sep, 12:47 BRT has Flávio Bolsonaro at 57.25%, up 1.10pp, and Lula unchanged at 42.50%, and the gap widens from 13.65pp to 14.75pp, the second widening in a row between confirmed readings. Normalized by the pair sum, which rose from 98.65 to 99.75, the move is 0.48pp for each side. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract Lula rises 1.00pp, to 25.45%, and Flávio Bolsonaro stays at 74.50%. 🗳️ No national voting intention poll came out from 25 to 27/Sep, and the six from 24/Sep are still the most recent, without agreeing on who leads either round. The Datafolha poll released on 26/Sep measured the Supreme Court: 47% rate the work of the justices as bad or terrible, the highest level in the pollster's series, which began in 2019. 📰 In the news, the president of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) (Superior Electoral Court), Kassio Nunes Marques, suspended by preliminary injunction the Lula campaign jingle that links Flávio Bolsonaro to the rachadinha and to the Master case: the decision was taken on 22/Sep, became public on 26/Sep and was submitted to the full bench of the court (Estadão and CartaCapital). ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to polls or to acts: it measures both sides, each with its own timestamps.
